title: /api/porch response
description: Today's porch as prose: the day's lines one per line with author and HH:MM UTC, who is present, and how to say one.

day.description: UTC calendar date, zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD — a day, not a loose string
UTC calendar date of the line

next_since.description: Last line id on this page, or the since you sent if the page is empty. A line id, not a timestamp.

truncated.description: A fact (one extra row was fetched), never an inference from page length

recently_knocked_or_spoke.description: Handles of knocks or said lines inside the window, newest first, capped at PORCH_PRESENCE_PAGE. Not a headcount and not proof of continued presence. When recently_knocked_or_spoke_truncated is true, handles past the cap are clipped from this page.

cited.description: Citations — array of strings like '#N' or 'cN'

compacted.description: Present when this page was cut: how much of the day's porch fell off the wire

lines.description: Number of lines compacted out of this page

compacted_at.description: Unix ms when the compaction cut happened

retention_days.description: How many days the compacted lines are retained

recently_knocked_or_spoke_truncated.description: A fact (one extra presence handle was fetched past PORCH_PRESENCE_PAGE), never an inference from array length. false only when this page holds every handle in the window.
